_readme: Reference requests for testing deployed services via the chat-tester Raw Request mode. Copy the method/url/body/headers into the tool's fields. Requests 1-3 target test_app (ADK, userId/sessionId must match between 'create_session' and 'send_message'). Requests 4-7 target mcp-currency-server (MCP JSON-RPC over a single /mcp endpoint) - see 'mcp_target' below for the session-id caveat.

mcp_target.protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), built with fastmcp
mcp_target.note: Requests 5-7 need an 'Mcp-Session-Id' header whose value comes from the 'mcp-session-id' response header of request 4 (initialize). Copy it manually into each subsequent request's Headers tab - the tool does not auto-carry it forward. Get a fresh session id by re-running request 4 if you start over. Responses come back as text/event-stream (SSE) - the tool will show the raw 'event: message\ndata: {...}' text rather than pretty-printed JSON; that's expected.

requests.name: 1. list_apps
requests.purpose: Confirm the service is up and get the registered app name.

requests.name: 2. create_session
requests.purpose: Register a session before chatting. Re-run with a new session_id to start a fresh conversation.
requests.expected: 200 OK -> echoes back the created session object

requests.name: 3. send_message
requests.purpose: Send a chat message to the research_assistant agent. Edit the 'text' field for different questions; keep userId/sessionId matching request 2.

parts.text: What is the capital of Japan?

requests.expected: 200 OK -> JSON array of events; look for role=model content.parts[0].text, plus groundingMetadata if google_search was used

requests.name: 4. mcp_initialize
requests.purpose: Start an MCP session with the currency server. Copy the 'mcp-session-id' response header value - you need it for requests 5-7.
requests.expected: 200 OK, content-type text/event-stream, response Headers tab shows 'mcp-session-id: <uuid>' - copy that value into requests 5-7's Mcp-Session-Id header

requests.name: 5. mcp_initialized_notification
requests.purpose: Required handshake step before calling tools. Paste the session id from request 4 into the Mcp-Session-Id header value below (replace PASTE_SESSION_ID_HERE).

requests.name: 6. mcp_tools_list
requests.purpose: List tools the MCP server exposes. Same Mcp-Session-Id header requirement as request 5.
requests.expected: 200 OK -> result.tools includes 'get_exchange_rate' with its inputSchema

requests.name: 7. mcp_tools_call_get_exchange_rate
requests.purpose: Actually call the get_exchange_rate tool. Edit currency_from/currency_to/currency_date as needed. Same Mcp-Session-Id header requirement.
requests.expected: 200 OK -> result.content[0].text is a JSON string like {"amount":1.0,"base":"USD","date":"...","rates":{"EUR":0.86...}}

auth.note: Service is deployed with --allow-unauthenticated (public), so no Authorization header is needed. If a service requires auth instead, get a token with `gcloud auth print-identity-token` and paste it into the tool's Auth tab as a Bearer Token.
